FIG. 03 — WHY RAYANTRA

What working with us actually looks like.

Sized to your site

No fixed catalog to squeeze you into — systems are sized to the site, whether that's a single rooftop, a farm, or a full industrial plant.

Supply and installation, one team

Rayantra handles both directly, so there's one point of contact from quote to commissioning — not a handoff between separate vendors.

Direct access to the team

Reach the people actually running the business — not a call center. Phone and email go straight through.

4 years of hands-on experience

Four years of solar work behind every system we supply — and a 25-year warranty on all panels.

Government subsidy supported

Rayantra supports government solar subsidy schemes. Eligibility and the subsidy amount depend on the scheme, your segment, and your location — share your site details and we'll tell you what applies to you.
